# Workflows & Data Integrity Checklist: منصة مشاريع الطلاب (Student Projects Platform)

**Purpose**: Standard design/PR requirements-quality review covering proposal and defense state machines, submission versioning, completion % math, grade calculation, locking & re-evaluation, voting integrity, and concurrency/atomicity & year-rollover boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-11-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [research.md](../research.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | [contracts/README.md](../contracts/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Proposal State Machine

- [x] CHK001 - Are the preconditions and actor rules for entering `under_review` clearly specified—including whether a reviewing supervisor must explicitly invoke `START_REVIEW` before `REQUEST_CHANGES`/`RECOMMEND`, and how `reviewerId` is populated when no supervisor has been assigned yet? [Clarity, Spec §FR-037, Data Model §3, Contract §projects — specified in `data-model.md` §3]
- [x] CHK002 - Are the distinct enforcement boundaries between `registrationClosesAt` and `proposalDeadline` unambiguously defined—specifically whether a team in `needs_changes` may still resubmit after `proposalDeadline` if changes were requested near the cutoff? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-031, Data Model §3 — specified in `data-model.md` §3]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the transition target unambiguously specified when a Department/College Admin returns a `supervisor_recommended` proposal to `needs_changes` (confirming whether resubmission must pass Step 1 supervisor review again or return directly to Step 2 admin decision)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-037, Data Model §3 — specified in `data-model.md` §3]
- [x] CHK004 - Are side-effect cleanup rules defined for pending `TeamInvitation`, `LeadershipTransfer`, and `AdoptionRequest` records when a proposal transitions to `approved`, `rejected`, or `withdrawn`, or when the team leader is deactivated mid-workflow? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §3 — specified in `data-model.md` §3]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements consistent on whether assigning a primary supervisor is optional or mandatory prior to proposal `APPROVE` (and if optional, how supervisor-gated actions like phase adjustments and defense sign-off behave while the project is unassigned)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-038, Spec §FR-039, Spec §FR-123 — specified in `data-model.md` §3]

## Defense State Machine

- [x] CHK006 - Are regression or blocking rules defined if a deliverable approval is revoked or modified *after* a supervisor has signed off on defense eligibility (`eligible`) or after a defense has been `scheduled`? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-056, Spec §FR-082, Data Model §6 — specified in `data-model.md` §6 & `contracts/tracking.md`]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the conflict-of-interest rule reconciled between `Spec §FR-083` (supervisor cannot be chair or *only* examiner) and `Data Model §6` (primary/co-supervisor cannot be a committee examiner whose score counts in the committee component)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-083, Data Model §6 — reconciled in `data-model.md` §6]
- [x] CHK008 - Are deliberation-cycle rules under `FR-086a` completely specified—including whether `UNLOCK_FOR_REVISION` unlocks all examiners or selected ones, whether deliberation rounds are bounded, and what occurs if an examiner does not resubmit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-086a, Data Model §6, Contract §evaluation — specified in `data-model.md` §6 & `contracts/evaluation.md`]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the coupling between the main defense state (`finalized`) and the post-defense `modifications` sub-state (`pending`/`overdue`/`confirmed`) clearly defined—specifically whether students may download their official result letter/certificate while required modifications remain unconfirmed or overdue? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-088, Spec §FR-089, Research §R-08 — specified in `data-model.md` §6 & `contracts/evaluation.md`]
- [x] CHK010 - Are defense scheduling conflict rules quantified with exact overlap boundaries (e.g., adjacent back-to-back slots `10:00–11:00` and `11:00–12:00`, default `durationMin`, and online defenses without a physical room)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-084, Data Model §6, Contract §evaluation — specified in `data-model.md` §6]

## Submission & Proposal Versioning

- [x] CHK011 - Are submission version-lifecycle rules explicitly specified when a team uploads version `n+1` while version `n` is still `submitted` (unreviewed) or already `approved`—clarifying whether uploading a new version supersedes unreviewed work, invalidates an approval, or is disallowed once approved? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-052, Spec §FR-053, Data Model §4 — specified in `data-model.md` §4 & `contracts/tracking.md`]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the late-flagging rule (`isLate`) unambiguously specified across multi-version submissions and supervisor-adjusted due dates (e.g., v1 on time with changes requested, v2 after due date), including how `FR-125` aggregates late-submission rates without double-counting versions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-051, Spec §FR-053, Spec §FR-125 — specified in `data-model.md` §4 & `contracts/reports.md`]
- [x] CHK013 - Are `ProposalVersion` creation triggers consistent between `Spec §FR-005` (versioned history for proposal edits) and `Contract §projects` (creating versions only on edits after first submission), including how idea-adoption pre-fills are recorded? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §3, Contract §projects — specified in `data-model.md` §3]
- [x] CHK014 - Are phase-template selection and fallback rules defined for proposal approval when a college has multiple active templates or no active template configured at the time of approval? [Gap, Spec §FR-050, Spec §FR-051, Data Model §4 — specified in `data-model.md` §4]

## Completion Percentage Math

- [x] CHK015 - Are rounding and arithmetic precision rules (intermediate precision, final rounding to 1 decimal place, and `±0.001` weight-sum tolerance) explicitly defined so fully approved projects always compute to exactly `100%` rather than `99.9%` or `100.1%`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-056, Spec §SC-007, Research §R-22 — specified in `research.md` §R-22]
- [x] CHK016 - Are rules for optional (`required: false`) deliverables and supervisor modifications to project-copy phases explicitly defined so adding/removing deliverables cannot silently break the 100% weight sum or `requiredCount` denominator? [Completeness, Spec §FR-051, Spec §FR-056, Data Model §4 — specified in `data-model.md` §4 & `contracts/tracking.md`]
- [x] CHK017 - Are approval-revocation triggers and endpoints consistently specified between `Spec §FR-056` ("if an approval is revoked or changed, completion % MUST recalculate immediately") and `Contract §tracking` (including revoking a zero-deliverable phase completion)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-056, Contract §tracking — specified in `contracts/tracking.md`]
- [x] CHK018 - Are boundary calculation cases (zero-deliverable phases, non-terminating weight fractions, late-approved deliverables, and excluded milestones/Kanban tasks) captured as objectively measurable acceptance criteria? [Measurability, Spec §FR-056, Spec §SC-007, Research §R-22 — verified in `research.md` §R-22 & `T064`]

## Grade Calculation

- [x] CHK019 - Are the exact normalization and display formulas explicitly specified for the project's standalone `teamGrade` when a rubric mixes Team and Individual criteria (e.g., whether a 70%-weighted Team subset is normalized to 0–100 or displayed out of 70) and when `maxScore ≠ 100`? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-080, Spec §FR-086, Research §R-22 — specified in `research.md` §R-22]
- [x] CHK020 - Are rounding rules and boundary tie-breakers explicitly defined at pass-mark and grade-band cutoffs (e.g., whether `59.95` rounds before or after comparison against `passMark = 60`, and whether band thresholds like `85%` evaluate raw or rounded scores)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-090, Spec §FR-124, Research §R-22 — specified in `research.md` §R-22]
- [x] CHK021 - Are supervisor-component scoring rules specified when a project has co-supervisors or when the primary supervisor is deactivated mid-cycle (clarifying whether only the primary supervisor scores, whether co-supervisors can substitute, or how the supervisor component is filled)? [Gap, Spec §FR-038, Spec §FR-086, Spec §Edge Cases — specified in `data-model.md` §6]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the spread-threshold evaluation (`FR-086a`) unambiguously specified with respect to strict `>` vs. `>=`, single-examiner committee handling, and whether spread is checked per-student final totals, per-team totals, or both? [Clarity, Spec §FR-086a, Research §R-22, Contract §evaluation — specified in `research.md` §R-22]
- [x] CHK023 - Are examiner-scoring and finalization requirements defined for a student who was removed or moved off a team after approval, clarifying whether that student is excluded from the scoresheet so `SCORES_INCOMPLETE` does not block finalization? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-081, Contract §evaluation — specified in `data-model.md` §6]

## Grade Locking & Re-Evaluation

- [x] CHK024 - Is the one-request-per-student/project quota (`FR-087`) consistently aligned with `Data Model §6`'s unique index `{projectId: 1, studentId: 1}`—specifically clarifying how a supervisor-initiated project-wide request (`studentId: null` vs. per-student records) interacts with individual student quotas? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-087, Data Model §6, Contract §evaluation — aligned in `data-model.md` §6 & `contracts/evaluation.md`]
- [x] CHK025 - When a single student's re-evaluation request is approved, is it explicitly specified whether the committee may revise only that student's Individual criteria or also shared Team criteria—and if Team criteria change, whether teammates' locked grades are affected or remain frozen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-081, Spec §FR-087, Data Model §6 — specified in `data-model.md` §6]
- [x] CHK026 - Are full workflow rules specified for re-evaluation with a `replacementCommittee`—including whether the supervisor's original score carries over or is re-entered, whether COI (`FR-083`) and spread-threshold (`FR-086a`) rules apply identically, and whether further re-evaluations are blocked after re-finalization? [Coverage, Spec §FR-087, Contract §evaluation — specified in `data-model.md` §6]
- [x] CHK027 - Are versioned-grade retention and query rules consistent across `Constitution §IV`, `Data Model §6`, and `Spec §FR-124` so prior finalized `Grade` versions remain immutable in history while evaluation reports and certificates read strictly the latest finalized version per student? [Consistency, Constitution §IV, Spec §FR-087, Spec §FR-124, Research §R-09 — `isLatest` flag & index in `data-model.md` §6]

## Voting Integrity

- [x] CHK028 - Are the relationship and isolation rules between general showcase `votes` and `competitionvotes` unambiguously defined—specifically whether competition votes affect a project's general `validVotes`/7-day trending score and whether vote withdrawal is disabled once a competition ends? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-104, Spec §FR-106, Data Model §7, Contract §showcase — specified in `data-model.md` §7 & `contracts/showcase.md`]
- [x] CHK029 - Are burst-flagging semantics (`FR-105`) clearly specified—defining whether only excess votes beyond the per-IP threshold are flagged or the entire burst window is retroactively flagged, and how clearing or rejecting a flagged vote updates `validVotes` and `votes7d` atomically? [Clarity, Spec §FR-105, Research §R-19, Contract §showcase — specified in `research.md` §R-19]
- [x] CHK030 - Are vote-reconciliation requirements defined for post-vote state changes, including when a voter's account is deactivated (normal vs. impostor release `FR-013a`), when a voter later joins the project team/supervision, or when a project is taken down and republished? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-013a, Spec §FR-104 — specified in `data-model.md` §7]
- [x] CHK031 - Are competition closing-boundary requirements (exact `endsAt` inclusivity, timezone reference, and race between a last-second vote and the closing job writing `frozenRanking`) explicitly specified so final rankings remain deterministic? [Completeness, Spec §FR-106, Spec §US6-8, Data Model §7 — specified in `data-model.md` §7]

## Concurrency, Atomicity & Year-Rollover Integrity

- [x] CHK032 - Are atomic transaction boundaries explicitly specified for concurrent high-contention mutations—specifically two invitees accepting the last team slot (`teamSizeMax`), a student concurrently accepting two project invitations (`ProjectMembership` lock), and concurrent vote inserts/withdrawals? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030, Spec §FR-033, Data Model §3, Research §R-08 — specified in `data-model.md` §3 & `research.md` §R-19]
- [x] CHK033 - Are concurrency and optimistic-locking requirements defined for simultaneous defense actions (examiners submitting grades at the exact moment the chair triggers `FINALIZE`, or concurrent `UNLOCK_FOR_REVISION` and score submission)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §R-08, Contract §evaluation — specified in `data-model.md` §6 & `contracts/evaluation.md`]
- [x] CHK034 - Are the exact allowed vs. prohibited operations on `archived` (post-rollover) projects enumerated across all modules—confirming audited re-evaluation and admin showcase takedown remain permitted while submissions, Kanban edits, BOM edits, chat messages, and new votes are blocked? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions, Contract §organization, Contract §tracking — specified in `contracts/organization.md` & `contracts/tracking.md`]
- [x] CHK035 - Are counter-reconciliation and recovery requirements defined for denormalized fields (`projects.progress.percent`, `projects.budgetEstimate`, `projects.showcaseStats.validVotes`, `statscaches`) so periodic jobs or admin actions can detect and repair drift without violating `SC-007` or `SC-008`? [Recovery, Spec §SC-007, Spec §SC-008, Research §R-14 — specified in `research.md` §R-14]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
